name: Ellsworth AFB
description: Home of the 28th Bomb Wing. Ellsworth AFB operates B-1B Lancer conventional bomber missions and supports global strike operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Bismarck Gate (Commercial Gate)
gates.notes: Commercial and limited personal vehicle access. Closed weekends.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required.
gates.address: Visitor Control Center, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

resources.name: Raider Café (Dining Facility)
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting the 28th Bomb Wing with full meal service.

resources.name: Ellsworth Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: Sentinel Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Bellamy Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with weights, cardio, group exercise, indoor track, racquetball, basketball, steam rooms, sauna, and 24/7 access for registered CAC holders.
resources.hours: 24/7 for registered users; staffed hours vary
resources.address: 2370 Risner Drive, Bldg 7709, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

resources.name: Pine Tree Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.address: 1000 Ellsworth Street, Suite 1500, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

resources.name: 28th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, and recreational programs.
resources.address: 2570 George Drive, Bldg 4610, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

resources.name: Ellsworth Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: 28th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center
primaryAction.address: Visitor Control Center, Ellsworth AFB, SD 57706

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Pine Tree Inn (605-385-2844) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (605-385-2569) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 28 FSS, M&FRC, and official Ellsworth sites for in-processing and community support.
